## Fixes

- **Importing a picture into floor and roof tiles stored as wall-style blocks** now cuts it to the floor diamond as well. Some DT1s store floor or roof tiles this way, including Tal Rasha's tomb, Kurast roofs and many mod DT1s. Until now their pictures were rebuilt from the whole rectangle, so the parts outside the diamond showed in game. The editor says how many pixels were cut, and the tile shows exactly what will be saved.
